headline: Kenya Pipeline Company Foils Attempt to Siphon Fuel From Mombasa Pipeline
summary: The Kenya Pipeline Company foiled an attempt to steal petroleum products through an illegal connection on a pipeline linking two pumping stations in Mombasa County.
why: Security breaches and product theft along critical petroleum transit pipelines impact operational efficiency and transport loss management for national energy distributors.

impacts.name: Kenya
impacts.why: Pipeline tampering incidents create localized supply risks and security expenditures.
